title: Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A flavorful and comforting soup made with chicken, noodles, and Vietnamese spices. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot over high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
Stir in the fish sauce, soy sauce, and lime juice.
Return the chicken to the pot and cook until heated through.
Stir in the zesty seasoning, green onions, and cilantro.
Serve the soup hot and garnish with additional green onions and cilantro if desired.
